_help: Hand-held controllers the cabinets can name. Written by tools/pads/Update-PadCatalog.py from the public SDL controller list - do not edit by hand, change the rules in that script. A pad is found by USB id (pads), else by a piece of the name Windows reports (names; the longest match wins). family: the shape and button names (families). A pad switched to "X-input" mode shows up as an Xbox 360 controller: Windows cannot tell it apart, so 8BitDo pads are best left in D-input mode (hold START + B to turn on).

names.note: Windows calls a PS4 pad just "Wireless Controller"
most Retro-Bit USB pads on the cabinets are the Sega ones; the USB id decides when it is known
